name: frontier-kit
description: Monorepo: NestJS API (backend/) + React app (frontend/) for timed engineering challenges

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend run setup && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
